summary: The text discusses various aspects of education technology and the impact of technology on education, including the role of the FCC in regulating broadband access and internet safety policies. It presents arguments for and against various proposals related to E-Rate and CIPA, such as limiting or sunsetting E-Rate, changing eligibility criteria, and requiring network-level content filtering. The text presents a variety of viewpoints on the impact of E-Rate and related policies on education, technology use in schools, and the role of technology in education. It includes opinions from various stakeholders such as parents, school staff, and education experts. The text also cites various articles and reports discussing the use of technology in education, the backlash against screen time in schools, and the influence of technology on education. The text discusses the impact of AI on education, with research showing that AI use can negatively affect academic performance and confidence among students, particularly those with lower-performing teachers. The decline was more pronounced among teachers who reported heavier AI use at baseline.
